cases.name: paragraph
cases.ref: Okay, let's get started. Today we look at how a set-associative cache finds a line: the address is split into a tag, an index and an offset. The index selects one set; the tag tells us whether it's a hit. On a miss we fetch the whole 64-byte line from memory, and with a write-back policy a dirty line is only written out when it is evicted.
